chapter_title_en: A Demon for a Friend – The Gambling Challenge
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 147 – Ji Ning Risks It All in a Gambling Battle for 900 Liang of Primordial Liquid
chapter_meta_description: Beishan Hu's invincible great demon crushes six opponents. When the taunts hit nine hundred liang of Primordial Liquid, Ji Ning volunteers to kill the demon—or die trying. Anchan City's Wuyou Caverns boil with tension.
og_title: Desolate Era 147 – "As Easy as Killing a Chicken" – Ji Ning's Bold Gambit
og_description: A sworn brother's honor is on the line. Beishan Hu's rhinoceros demon is undefeated—until a fourteen-year-old sword cultivator steps into the cage.
twitter_title: Ji Ning vs the Horned Demon – 900 Liang of Primordial Liquid on the Line
twitter_description: In Anchan City's lawless gambling pits, Ji Ning volunteers to fight a Fiendgod-trained demon to save his friend's face.
